source_refs.title: Regulation (EC) No 883/2004 on the coordination of social security systems

calculation_limits: Does not calculate Italian statutory pension from first principles.
Does not create official P1 decisions.
Does not calculate tax, net amounts, exchange rates or application procedures.
Pro-rata amounts require a national theoretical amount and normalized periods.
limitations: Internal coordination dossier only; not an official INPS or Seguridad Social decision.
Periods are aggregated only to test entitlement and explain pro-rata mechanics.
Contributions remain under their national schemes and are not transferred or merged.
Human review is required before administrative or legal use.
